text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
SS Matches and Representative Matches— 
Project L'Arc's push toward the grand 
stage was steadily heightening the 
expectations of those around them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only the fans, but also those whose 
hearts once burned with romantic ambition, 
sent their passionate cheers to the 
project.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the team members began 
preparing for their long-term expedition 
to France.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Companions aiming for the same dream. The 
warm and harmonious atmosphere gave 
everyone a reassuring boost of confidence 
before the trip.
